name: EDC Sticky
summary: Everyday-carry companion: clock, alarm, timer, calculator, level, ruler, keyboard, recorder, game – useful alone, smart with the app.
description: Custom firmware plus an Android companion app. On its own the Sticky keeps working for days: a menu with groups and tabs – Time (timer, alarm, world time), Measure (spirit level, ruler mm/inch), Capture (voice recorder on microSD, on-screen keyboard and number pad, scribble pad, single-stroke handwriting), Calculate (calculator, unit converter) – plus QR cards, a castle-duel game and a trip/climate logger. German and English. The app adds offline speech-to-text, weather, manuals and cheat sheets, new pages and sync. Braun ET66-inspired design. A second firmware slot can hold the Sticky Lab.

compatibility.notes: Needs a microSD card. Pages, widgets and settings are set up once by the Android companion app (APK in the GitHub releases); afterwards the Sticky works without the phone.

assets.previewAlt: reTerminal Sticky with the EDC firmware: timer page in portrait with Braun-style keys on e-paper

notes.title: Back up the factory firmware first
notes.description: It contains device-specific data: esptool read-flash 0 0x2000000 backup.bin. Restore with write-flash 0 backup.bin.

notes.title: microSD card needed
notes.description: Menu, widgets, help and handwriting live on a FAT32 microSD card. Without the app, copy the "soll" folder from edc-sticky-sd-basekit-0.39.2.zip (GitHub release, English; -de.zip German) to the card.

notes.title: Companion app
notes.description: Install the Android app from the GitHub releases and connect once: it sets the clock and copies pages, widgets and settings to the microSD card.

notes.title: First boot without the app
notes.description: Shows a card with a QR code to the project page. With the microSD base kit: AI short on Home opens the menu (groups with tabs); ▲/▼ = pages, ▲+▼ = help.

notes.title: Sticky Lab in slot 2 (optional)
notes.description: EDC runs from app0. The Sticky Lab (0.8.1 or later) can sit next to it in app1: esptool write-flash 0x410000 sticky-lab.bin (not the normal Lab install, that replaces EDC). Switch with the menu tile "Sticky Lab" or hold ▲ for 1 s at power-on. Accepting the erase prompt here also clears slot 2.
